title: A.e. strong measurability of sqrt det(p L* L p + I − p) for a.e. strongly measurable operator fields p, L
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, E := ℝ^P (Euclid P), μ a measure on E, and p, L : E → End(E) := (E →L[ℝ] E) (operator-norm topology) both μ-a.e. strongly measurable. Then x ↦ sqrt(det(p(x) ∘ (L(x)* ∘ L(x)) ∘ p(x) + (I − p(x)))) is μ-a.e. strongly measurable, where L(x)* is the adjoint of L(x), I is the identity of E and det is the determinant of an endomorphism of E.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (p L : Euclid P → (Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid P)), AEStronglyMeasurable p μ → AEStronglyMeasurable L μ → AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => Real.sqrt ((p x ∘L ((L x).adjoint ∘L L x) ∘L p x + (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Euclid P) - p x)).det)) μ
